description: This file defines the EngineChart class which is a data structure encapsulating a collection of engine-related parameters and logs, including references to injectors, sparks, trigger, map, and methods to access revolution logs and internal map data.

classes.name: EngineChart
classes.description: A data model representing engine parameters and logs, with methods to access revolution logs and internal state.

methods.name: EngineChart
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the EngineChart with a map of string keys to StringBuilder values.

methods.name: getRevolutionsLog
methods.description: Returns a RevolutionLog object parsed from the revolutions message in the map.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve the StringBuilder associated with a specific key from the map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the EngineChart instance.

methods.name: getMap
methods.description: Returns the internal map of engine data.
